note: Rough list prices for estimates only (GCP us-central1, AWS us-east-1, Anthropic first-party API, GitHub-hosted runners). Monthly ranges: low = smallest common size or idle, high = a busy small production size. Check the provider pricing page before a real decision. Projects override any row in .heyeddi/docs/engineering/budget.json under "rates".

cloud_run_min_instance.note: One warm instance, 1 vCPU / 512 MiB: idle billing (low) to busy all month (high)
cloud_run_min_instance.cheaper: min instances 0 with startup CPU boost; keep 1 only on the latency-critical service

cpu_always_allocated.note: CPU billed for the whole instance life, per instance
cpu_always_allocated.cheaper: request-based CPU unless you run background work after the response

google_sql_database_instance.cheaper: smallest tier for non-prod, stop it at night, or Neon / Firestore for small load

google_alloydb_instance.cheaper: Cloud SQL until AlloyDB features are needed

google_spanner_instance.cheaper: Cloud SQL unless you need global writes

google_container_cluster.cheaper: Cloud Run unless you need Kubernetes; one zonal cluster has a free management tier

google_container_node_pool.cheaper: spot nodes for stateless work; autoscale to the smallest count

google_compute_instance.cheaper: e2-micro or e2-small, spot VMs, or Cloud Run

google_compute_instance_template.cheaper: check the group size that uses it

google_compute_router_nat.cheaper: Private Google Access when traffic only goes to Google APIs

google_compute_global_forwarding_rule.cheaper: Cloud Run default URL or domain mapping when one service is enough

google_compute_forwarding_rule.cheaper: share one load balancer across services

google_compute_address.cheaper: release addresses you do not attach

google_compute_global_address.cheaper: release addresses you do not attach

google_vpc_access_connector.cheaper: Direct VPC egress on Cloud Run

google_redis_instance.cheaper: in-process cache or Firestore until the hit rate proves Redis

google_storage_bucket.cheaper: lifecycle rules to Nearline / delete old objects

google_bigquery_dataset.cheaper: partition and cluster tables; set default table expiry

google_cloud_scheduler_job.cheaper: three jobs per account are free

google_logging_project_sink.cheaper: filter the sink; drop debug logs

aws_instance.cheaper: t4g sizes, spot, or Lambda / Fargate

aws_db_instance.cheaper: smallest class for non-prod, single AZ outside prod

aws_rds_cluster.cheaper: Aurora Serverless v2 minimum ACU, or plain RDS

aws_nat_gateway.cheaper: VPC endpoints for AWS services; one NAT for non-prod

aws_lb.cheaper: share one load balancer with listener rules

aws_eks_cluster.cheaper: ECS Fargate or Lambda unless you need Kubernetes

aws_eip.cheaper: release addresses you do not attach

llm_cheaper: prompt caching for the stable prefix, Batch API (half price) for work that can wait, lower effort, and measure a smaller model on real requests before switching

firestore.note: Native mode: single region (low) to multi-region (high). First 50k reads/day are free per project.
